name: SolvBTC LSTs
description: SolvBTC LSTs, including xSolvBTC and SolvBTC.CORE, let you stake Bitcoin to secure blockchain networks while earning rewards, and 1:1 backed by Bitcoin. Unlike traditional staking, your assets remain liquid, ready to trade, lend, or provide liquidity - maximizing your Bitcoin’s earning potential.
methodology: Staked tokens via Babylon and Core are counted towards TVL, as they represent the underlying BTC assets securing their respective networks.
